key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers select device materials and design experiments, with the demonstrated solar cells reaching 27.05% power conversion efficiency.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence rather than conventional question–answer training.
Refine selected responses with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a recommended self-assembled monolayer contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted Pro raised Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1, while experimentally tested devices retained 96.74% efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
watch_item: The reported device validation concerns one contact-design test, and dark thermal ageing does not establish durability under illuminated operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
